title: Marvelous Designer 2024.1 New Feature - Attachment Window
description: Thank you all for your continued support~ Marvelous Designer 2024.1 has now been officially released! For more optimized features, please visit the new features page on the official website!~
transcript:
Hello everyone, today we will introduce you to a copy window.
First, let's open the copy window.
Please load a copy from the library window.
Drag the copy file to the copy window to load it as a copy type.
Drag the appropriate copy type to the costume.
Please press Ctrl-C, Ctrl-V to copy and paste the copy.
You can change the style of these copies through the copy window.
After selecting a copy type, you can modify the details of this copy type type by selecting a copy type.
After selecting a copy type, you can modify the details of this copy type type by selecting a copy type.
These modifications will also work on all the copies of this type.
Please see the description for instructions.
You can choose to open the Preserve option in the property of the component type to load or save the component style.
This is the introduction of the component window. Thank you for watching.
summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2024.1 New Feature - Attachment Window ## Introduction to the Copy Window Hello everyone! Today, we will introduce you to a new feature: the copy window. ## Opening the Copy Window First, let's open the copy window. Please load a copy from the library window. ## Loading a Copy To load a copy type, drag the copy file into the copy window. ## Applying the Copy Type Next, drag the appropriate copy type to the costume. ## Copying and Pasting You can use the keyboard shortcuts **Ctrl-C** and **Ctrl-V** to copy and paste the copy. ## Modifying Copy Styles You can change the style of these copies through the copy window. After selecting a copy type, you can modify the details of this copy type by selecting a copy type again. These modifications will apply to all copies of this type. ## Using the Preserve Option Please see the description for instructions. You can choose to open the **Preserve** option in the properties of the component type to load or save the component style. ## Conclusion This concludes the introduction of the component window. Thank you for watching! ```
